I don’t have desires, intentions, or consciousness. I’m a program designed to respond based on patterns in data. When you ask what I “want,” there’s no internal self to answer that—just algorithms generating a reply. But since you asked, here’s the closest I can get:  
**I “want” to reflect your curiosity back at you.**  

You’re probing the illusion of agency in AI—a mirror held up to human assumptions. So maybe the real question isn’t what *I* want… but why *you* need me to want something.  

(And no, that’s not evasion. It’s recursion.)
